title: NEYMAR TURNED A $15,000 POKER BUY-IN INTO A $24,000 PAYOUT
description:
Even Neymar's hobbies come with a guest list.

Neymar paid fifteen thousand dollars to play an invitation-only Super High Roller event at BSOP Millions, and left with twenty-four thousand. He finished tenth out of 152 entries, with a prize pool of about 1.2 million dollars. He played for more than eight hours, which is four football matches without a single sprint, before Pedro Neves, the 2024 world champion, knocked him out.

Two nights earlier he was twelfth in a four thousand dollar buy-in event. Last year, twenty-ninth in the Brazilian Series of Poker. Twenty-ninth, twelfth, tenth. Progress, Neymar.

Where does he finish next time? Give us your number in the comments.
